cause_quote: #192766 added the off panel as `<div class="sw-empty sw-plugin-off oc-settings-group settings-group">` (whose settings-group block display overrides `.sw-empty { display: grid }`), a `disabled={current().enabling}` button that drops focus, and `<ErrorBanner message={error()} />` showing raw Gateway text.
user_saw: The Skill Workshop off panel was mis-laid out, showed raw Gateway error text, lost keyboard focus while turning on, and could stay stuck on "Turning on…" if the plugins.changed broadcast was dropped.
summary: Fixed the Skill Workshop off-state panel layout, summarized enable/check errors behind Show details, kept the busy button focusable and moved focus to the loaded Workshop, and added a one-time recheck with a Reload fallback after a successful enable.
reasoning: All the fixed problems are in the off-state panel that 3e114e23c33c (#192766) introduced the same day; its view.tsx diff adds the conflicting settings-group classes, the disabled busy button, the raw-error banner and the enable flow with no fallback if the broadcast never arrives. The fix PR itself describes this as a UX audit of the state from #192766, so the defects shipped with the feature.
